name: ChatterStack LLM observability
target: OpenObserve saved views (Logs > explore > run query > Save view). Dashboard export JSON is build-specific, so these queries are the importable unit.

fields.trace_id: one chat request; shared by council stages and the embedding calls it made
fields.span: completion | council-member-answer | council-ranking | council-chair | title-generation | embedding | embeddings
fields.thinking_level: off | low | medium | high | xhigh | max
fields.stopped: true when the user pressed Stop
fields.input_tokens: provider usage when present, otherwise estimated
fields.output_tokens: provider usage when present, otherwise estimated
fields.estimated: true when the token counts came from the local tokenizer
fields.cost_usd: from src/config/models.ts pricing; absent for unpriced models
fields.attachment_count: files attached to the turn (bytes are never sent)
fields.rag_used: true when retrieved context was added

views.name: llm - p50 p95 latency per model
views.query: SELECT model, COUNT(*) AS calls, ROUND(AVG(duration_ms), 1) AS avg_ms, ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(duration_ms, 0.50), 1) AS p50_ms, ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(duration_ms, 0.95), 1) AS p95_ms FROM llm_calls GROUP BY model ORDER BY calls DESC

views.name: llm - error rate per model per day
views.query: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', TO_TIMESTAMP(_timestamp / 1000000)) AS day, model, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS error_pct FROM llm_calls GROUP BY day, model ORDER BY day DESC, error_pct DESC

views.name: llm - failure kinds
views.query: SELECT error_type, COUNT(*) AS n FROM llm_calls WHERE status <> 'ok' GROUP BY error_type ORDER BY n DESC

views.name: llm - status mix (errors, stops, rag use)
views.query: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(CASE WHEN stopped THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stopped, SUM(CASE WHEN rag_used THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_rag FROM llm_calls GROUP BY status

views.name: llm - tokens and cost per day
views.query: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', TO_TIMESTAMP(_timestamp / 1000000)) AS day, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens, ROUND(SUM(cost_usd), 6) AS cost_usd, SUM(CASE WHEN estimated THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS estimated_calls FROM llm_calls GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 90

views.name: llm - cost per model
views.query: SELECT model, ROUND(SUM(cost_usd), 6) AS cost_usd, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM llm_calls WHERE cost_usd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY model ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

views.name: llm - cost per user (top 50)
views.query: SELECT user_id, ROUND(SUM(cost_usd), 4) AS cost_usd, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM llm_calls WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY cost_usd DESC LIMIT 50

views.name: llm - council stage breakdown
views.query: SELECT span, model, COUNT(*) AS calls, ROUND(AVG(duration_ms), 1) AS avg_ms, ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(duration_ms, 0.95), 1) AS p95_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors FROM llm_calls WHERE span LIKE 'council%' GROUP BY span, model ORDER BY span, calls DESC

views.name: llm - slowest council runs
views.query: SELECT trace_id, COUNT(*) AS stages, COUNT(DISTINCT model) AS models, SUM(duration_ms) AS model_ms, MAX(_timestamp) - MIN(_timestamp) AS spread_us FROM llm_calls WHERE span LIKE 'council%' GROUP BY trace_id ORDER BY model_ms DESC LIMIT 50

views.name: llm - time to first token
views.query: SELECT model, thinking_level, ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(time_to_first_token_ms, 0.50), 1) AS p50_ttfb_ms, ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(time_to_first_token_ms, 0.95), 1) AS p95_ttfb_ms FROM llm_calls WHERE time_to_first_token_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY model, thinking_level ORDER BY model, thinking_level

views.name: llm - one chat request end to end
views.note: Replace the trace_id value; this is how a slow or failed chat is read back.
views.query: SELECT timestamp, span, model, status, duration_ms, time_to_first_token_ms, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd, finish_reason FROM llm_calls WHERE trace_id = 'paste-a-trace-id-here' ORDER BY _timestamp
